name: judged-relevance-compaction-replaces-the-summary
description: With relevance compaction on in both lanes' own config files, a manual compaction asks the judge which of the earlier tool results the task still needs, and the exact text of the kept ones replaces the host's summary; the compaction's requests and its result are the same on both sides. The original is pointed at the fake judge with its own typesafeBackend endpoint and the port with TYPESAFE_BASE_URL. BLOCKED (host difference, not the port's): the compact response carries estimatedTokensAfter, which PiG computes as 12941 and Pi as 12938 for the same compaction (the original under PiG, pig-ts, and the port, pig-go, both say 12941), and a random firstKeptEntryId. Everything else, the judge's requests, the kept and left-out units and the summary text, is equal in the three lanes.
